en: A black‑and‑white aerial view of a large, formal city square with lawns and flowerbeds. At the center stands an ornate Baroque column or monument surrounded by an octagonal platform, and in the foreground there is an equestrian statue on a high pedestal. Benches line the paths and people are walking and sitting around the square; a multi‑storey building and a street with vehicles border the square. The reverse side has printed multilingual text identifying the place as Széchenyi tér (Széchenyi Square) in Pécs, Hungary, along with handwritten Hungarian text, an address, postage stamp and a Pécs postmark dated 1967.
